items.raw_excerpt: More than 200 guests turned out for Drive ÉLAN’s Portuguese launch at The Yard in Vale do Lobo.

items.raw_excerpt: British musician Rod Stewart’s farewell tour will stop at the Marés festival in Matosinhos on 16 July of next year, organisers announced.
items.summary_en: British singer Rod Stewart will bring his farewell tour to the Marés festival in Matosinhos, Portugal. The concert is set for 16 July next year. Festival organisers announced the news.

items.raw_excerpt: This might be a (raspberry) pie in the sky plan, but it's part of a global movement searching for answers to digital sovereignty and tech resilience.
items.summary_en: A group of punks is part of a global movement. They want people to control their own technology. They call this idea digital sovereignty.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents at Darwin's biggest short-stay accommodation facility say they feel "like cattle being chased from a station" as the Northern Territory government prepares to bus them 100km to Batchelor.
items.summary_en: Residents of Darwin's biggest short-stay accommodation say they feel like cattle being moved. The Northern Territory government will bus them about 100 kilometers away to Batchelor.
items.summary_ko: 다윈 최대 단기 거주 시설의 주민들이 가축처럼 쫓겨나는 기분이라고 말합니다. 북부준주 정부는 버스로 약 100킬로미터 떨어진 배처러 지역으로 이주시킬 계획입니다.
items.title_en: Short-stay home closes and residents face a long move

items.title_original: YiSSA closes as short-stay residents prepare to be bussed to Batchelor

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico City chefs were dismayed when their ambitious "Pay What You Can" experiment was instead interpreted as a "Pay if You Want To" plan.
items.summary_en: A Mexico City restaurant called El Jalapeño tried a pay-what-you-can plan. Most customers chose not to pay, and the experiment earned only 84 pesos. The chefs were astonished by the result.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코시티의 엘 할라페뇨 식당은 '원하는 만큼만 내세요' 실험을 시작했다. 하지만 손님 대부분이 내지 않았고 모인 금액은 84페소뿐이었다. 주방장들은 그 결과에 크게 놀랐다.
items.title_en: Mexico City chefs shocked as pay-what-you-can experiment earns just 84 pesos
items.title_ko: 멕시코시티 식당 '원하는 만큼 내세요' 실험, 84페소만 모여
items.title_original: El Jalapeño: Mexico City chefs astonished after ‘Pay What You Can’ experiment generates only 84 pesos

items.raw_excerpt: A technical glitch in the New Zealand Customs service has eGates down for both departing and arriving travellers at Auckland Airport
items.summary_en: A technical problem stopped eGates at Auckland Airport. The gates are down for both leaving and arriving travelers. Officials warn that people may face delays.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 공항에서 eGate에 기술적 오류가 발생했다. 출국과 입국하는 여행객 모두 이 게이트를 이용할 수 없게 되었다. 당국은 지연이 생길 수 있다고 경고했다.
items.title_en: eGate outage causes delays at Auckland Airport
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 공항 eGate 장애로 지연 경보
items.title_original: Delay warnings as eGate outage hits Auckland Airport

items.raw_excerpt: There’s definitely something about the Algarve that makes food taste better.
items.summary_en: The Algarve in Portugal has many good places to eat. Local food there always tastes better. This guide shares some great spots to try.

items.raw_excerpt: A bus named after a family Cavoodle is helping reconnect Sunraysia commuters to South Australia.
items.summary_en: A bus now runs again between Mildura and South Australia after a six-year break. The service is named after a family's Cavoodle dog. It helps local commuters travel between the two places.

items.title_en: Bus service reconnects Mildura and South Australia after six years

items.raw_excerpt: Hundreds of get-well messages and art pieces have been sent to the tortoise before he undergoes a bladder surgery on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Gus is a 104-year-old gopher tortoise living in Halifax, Canada. Hundreds of people sent get-well messages and art pieces before his bladder surgery on Tuesday.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 핼리팩스에 사는 104살 고퍼거북 구스가 화요일 방광 수술을 앞두고 있습니다. 수백 명이 쾌유를 비는 메시지와 그림을 보내왔습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Birdsville Track has been closed for the majority of the past two years, leaving some outback businesses with no choice but to pause operations.
items.summary_en: The Birdsville Track in outback Australia has been closed for most of the past two years. With so few travellers able to pass, some small local businesses have been forced to stop operating. The remote road is a key lifeline for these tiny communities.
items.summary_ko: 호주 아웃백의 버즈빌 트랙이 지난 2년 동안 대부분 폐쇄되었습니다. 여행자가 거의 지나갈 수 없게 되면서 일부 작은 사업체들은 영업을 멈출 수밖에 없었습니다. 이 외딴 도로는 지역 사회의 중요한 생명선입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A brand of turkey gravy sold in Canada has been recalled because it contains undeclared mustard.
items.summary_en: A brand of turkey gravy sold in Canada has been recalled. The gravy contains mustard that is not listed on the label. Mustard can cause serious reactions in people with allergies.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다에서 판매된 한 칠면조 그레이비 브랜드가 리콜되었습니다. 이 제품에는 라벨에 표기되지 않은 겨자가 들어 있습니다. 겨자는 알레르기가 있는 사람에게 심각한 반응을 일으킬 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Turkey gravy sold in Canada recalled over undeclared mustard

items.summary_en: In Tuxtepec, the informational stage of a comprehensive reform to the state constitution has begun. The process aims to recognize interculturality in Oaxaca. Governor Salomon Jara said the people will write the new constitution.

items.raw_excerpt: Eyewitness News travelled to Phugwane village near Malamulele in Limpopo, where water had not flowed from communal taps in more than a decade.
items.summary_en: Eyewitness News visited Phugwane village near Malamulele in Limpopo. The communal taps there have been dry for more than ten years. Villagers are forced to drink water from a dirty puddle.
items.summary_ko: 방송 기자가 림포포 지방 말라물렐레 근처의 푸과네 마을을 찾았다. 그곳 공용 수도꼭지에는 10년 넘게 물이 흐르지 않았다. 주민들은 오염된 웅덩이에서 나온 물을 마시며 겨우 살아가고 있다.
items.title_en: We won't vote without water: Limpopo villagers drink from a filthy puddle
items.title_ko: 물 없이는 투표 안 한다, 림포포 주민들 오물 웅덩이 물로 생활
items.title_original: FEATURE |‘ We won’t vote without water’: Limpopo villagers forced to drink from filthy puddle - EWN

items.raw_excerpt: A foreign national has been stranded in the Cook Islands for three years. Despite assistance from Cook Islands Immigration, neither New Zealand nor Australia has approved a transit visa for her return home.

items.summary_en: Farmers in Australia are using small sensors to track their cows and newborn calves. These tools help them spot problems early and save time.

items.raw_excerpt: The Metropolitan Police Bureau (MPB) has banned public gatherings around the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), venues hosting official functions and hotels accommodating delegates to the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026 until Oct 20.
items.summary_en: Bangkok police have banned public gatherings near the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center and nearby hotels. The ban is in place for delegates attending the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026. It lasts until October 20.

items.raw_excerpt: If AI is biased towards AI, it adds a fresh dimension of jeopardy in the dismal hiring arms race, says the Financial Times’ Pilita Clark.
items.summary_en: A commentary warns that AI hiring tools may favor resumes written by AI. This could push job seekers to rely more on AI, making the hiring race even worse.
items.summary_ko: 한 칼럼은 AI 채용 도구가 AI가 작성한 이력서를 더 선호할 수 있다고 경고한다. 이는 구직자들이 AI에 더 의존하게 만들어 채용 경쟁을 더욱 악화시킬 수 있다.
items.title_en: Commentary: What if HR's AI prefers AI-written resumes?
items.title_ko: 칼럼: 인사팀 AI가 AI가 쓴 이력서를 더 선호하면?
